name: Tissue
summary: For florists who sell on Instagram and TikTok, often from a home studio: the home page is their feed. Fresh and Forever switch the range; a pinned post (a still or a short muted clip) comes first, the rest flows round it in a strict three-column grid, each bouquet with its name, price and an italic "Ask for this one". The weekly drop is one post in the feed. Warm white page, colour from the tissue, ribbon and flowers; a peony-petal accent on text and lines only. Tenor Sans in normal case and Spectral; square photos, no pills. The pearl pin, one satin-ribbon divider and a handwritten-style card are the motifs.
